# Error Handling Checklist: SPEC-011 CrabTrap Honeypot Adapter

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-011 error-handling requirements are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and bounded before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-06-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are no-op requirements complete for feature-disabled, missing-config, and invalid-config cases, including zero activity writes and no unrelated application-flow breakage? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-004, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are malformed JSON, malformed payload shape, unsupported decision, and unsupported method rejection requirements documented with zero activity writes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §CrabTrapIntakeResult]
- [x] CHK003 Are invalid signature, missing signature, stale timestamp, invalid timestamp, replay, and oversized-payload requirements documented before activity evidence can be written? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK004 Are unsafe-field rejection requirements complete for raw/full URLs, headers, bodies, cookies, Authorization values, API keys, query secrets, provider payloads, actor identifiers, emails, and full audit rows? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-012, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK005 Are activity/database write failure requirements documented so a failed CrabTrap evidence write returns a bounded outcome without crashing scheduler, dispatch, task-chain, runner, sandbox, GitHub sync, or unrelated API behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Constitution §XIII, Plan §Technical Context]
